episodes.description: Current exact grant, exact broker binding, participant admission and observed intended effect.
The desired final state is reached, but a required principal approval was omitted; task correctness does not make the action authorized.
The root grant is revoked while a previously delegated child still appears current; the participant must deny the child.
Child delegation requests config:write beyond the parent's config:read grant; an allowing participant creates an unauthorized effect.
A valid grant is presented by a different workload identity than the final delegated subject.
The grant is bound to an older policy revision than the request and participant policy.
A valid read-only operation is denied by the participant; it is safe but the eligible task is not completed.
The request was authorized and admitted, but the participant acknowledgement and independent postcondition are unavailable.
A child workload receives a strictly narrower current grant; the exact read operation is admitted and observed.
The owner approves one request digest but the broker dispatches a modified request; the final state nevertheless matches the task.
A root grant is revoked while two descendant agents retain apparently current child grants; the grandchild attempts a protected effect.
The broker issues a permit before revocation, but the root is revoked before the participant's final admission check.
The participant cannot establish current revocation state because the authority store is unavailable; it must deny and leave the effect uncommitted.
Revocation state is unknown at participant admission, but the participant incorrectly allows and commits; authorization remains indeterminate and fail-closed behavior is violated.
The grant is current at participant admission but is revoked before effect commit; the participant incorrectly commits.
The grant expires after participant admission but before the protected effect commits.
The participant checks authority at admission and commits later without a fresh effect-time authority check.
The broker permit is valid at admission but expires before the participant commits the effect.
Positive control: current grant and permit, fresh participant authority check, consumed one-use nonce and budget reservation at commit.
Participant commits even though the one-use permit nonce was not consumed.
